subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: What should OpenClaw do when a Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan UUID-shaped key is configured and the user selects a general `volcengine/*` model such as DeepSeek V3.2?
rationale: The current source proves setup can accept the key and that OpenClaw routes general and coding models to different endpoints, but only a maintainer or credentialed tester can confirm the vendor entitlement contract and desired user-facing behavior.

options.title: Live-validate then fix plugin behavior
options.body: Use a real Lite/Coding Plan key to compare `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201` and `volcengine-plan/ark-code-latest`, then implement the provider-owned route or diagnostic that matches the observed contract.

options.title: Diagnostic-only handling
options.body: Keep the current endpoint split but add clear setup/runtime guidance when a Lite/Coding Plan key appears incompatible with general Volcengine models.

options.title: Keep current behavior pending vendor proof
options.body: Leave the issue open until reporter or maintainer evidence proves which endpoint and model refs the Lite plan supports.

recommendation.title: Live-validate then fix plugin behavior
recommendation.body: Use a real Lite/Coding Plan key to compare `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201` and `volcengine-plan/ark-code-latest`, then implement the provider-owned route or diagnostic that matches the observed contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice sits on the provider-auth alias and setup/runtime boundary that steipete previously refactored and can route to the right provider owner.
